title: Clone Graph
kidExplanation: Picture the puzzle 'Clone Graph'. Here is the clever trick in plain words: The problem is to clone an undirected graph. We can solve this using Depth-First Search (DFS) or Breadth-First Search (BFS). Here, I'm use DFS to traverse the original graph and create a new graph. We will still start slow, then use this trick so it becomes fast.
plainProblem: Clone Graph: Picture the puzzle 'Clone Graph'. Worked example — input: node adjList = [[2,4],[1,3],[2,4],[1,3]]; expected output: deep clone. Why: Same links new nodes. Interview pattern to name out loud: Graph BFS / DFS.
